name: A Binding Contract
label: Quest
description: A Binding Contract: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The undersigned hereby declares that the Sulfuron ingot they are delivering to the Thorium Brotherhood (TB Ltd.) is genuine and not a facsimile thereof. The undersigned also acknowledges that any harm that should come to them as a result of attempting to build, forge, find, create, sell, or eat Sulfuras, is not the responsibility or fault of TB Ltd.
By signing this contract, you are agreeing to all terms listed herein.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It has been a pleasure doing business with you, friend!
On behalf of TB Ltd., I wish you luck in your search for Sulfuras!
